statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (J : Finset ℕ), 64 ≤ n → let I := (Finset.Icc ((n+2)/3) ((2*n)/3)).filter (fun u => u.Coprime n ∧ (J.filter (fun a => (a*u)%n = 1)).Nonempty); I.filter (fun u => Nat.sqrt n < (u*(n-u)).minFac) = I.filter (fun u => u.Prime ∧ (n-u).Prime)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Farey 分母对与逆元筛 · HD-8016 · 在任意逆元窗从终筛幸存者提取有序素数对
plain_statement.en: New route · Farey denominator pairs and inverse sieve · HD-8016 · Identify terminal sieve survivors with ordered prime pairs in any inverse window

brief.zh: 中心窗的两侧都大于 √n。若其中一侧为合数，其最小素因子的平方不超过该侧大小，于是该点已被筛去。逆元条件在两个集合中保持一致。
brief.en: Both denominator sides exceed the square root of n. A composite side has a prime factor at most its square root, so the terminal sieve removes that point. Keep the same inverse constraint on both sets.
